core_obligations: Set up the framework lemma: assumptions (1) and (2) follow from the cited \'etale-locality lemma for quasi-compact morphisms (proof lines 1386-1391).
Reduce: it is enough to show $Y \times_Z X$ is quasi-compact for every affine scheme $Y \to Z$ (proof lines 1391-1396).

Cube diagram: all squares cartesian, the bottom square consists of affine schemes; $f'$ quasi-compact and $Y \times_Z Z'$ affine imply $Y \times_Z Z' \times_Z X$ is quasi-compact (proof lines 1396-1412).
The morphism $Y \times_Z Z' \times_Z X \to Y \times_Z X$ is surjective as a base change of $Z' \to Z$, so $Y \times_Z X$ is quasi-compact by the cited surjection lemma (proof lines 1412-1425).
proof_roadmap: Feed the locality assumptions into the framework lemma.
Reduce to fibres over affine test schemes.
Use the chart to get a quasi-compact cover of the test fibre.
Conclude by surjection from a quasi-compact source.
difficulty_reason: The proof runs the framework lemma with the cube diagram: quasi-compactness is reduced to fibres over affine test schemes, the base change along $Y \times_Z Z' \to Y$ (affine, flat, surjective) shows the test fibre is quasi-compact over the chart, and a surjection from a quasi-compact space concludes.
